character.name:
The Manananggal (The Boss)
Visual Description: A beautiful yet grotesque girl representing the severed upper half of her body

Physical Traits: Massive, leathery black wings  in its backwith a sickening skeletal structure. Her fingers end in long, blood-stained claws.

Abilities: Fast, erratic flight patterns and the ability to swoop low for slashing attacks. Features a red "flicker" effect to indicate rapid regeneration.
